ui.report.inconclusive: the artifact could not be fully read
ui.key.created: Created a new signing key at {path} (mode 0600).
ui.verify.advisory_legend: [{mark}] a known limit on what this verification can claim, not something that went wrong. It does not change the result.
ui.check.files_match_manifest: every file matches the hash the manifest declares
ui.check.head_matches: the head hash matches the last entry
ui.check.merkle_root_matches: the Merkle root recomputes from the entries
ui.check.signature_valid: the signature verifies against a key in the package
ui.check.key_trusted: the signing key is one you already trust
ui.verify.extends: Checking that this package is an append-only extension of {older}
ui.attest.continued: Continuing the chain in {path} ({count} existing entries).
ui.attest.continue_invalid: Refusing to continue: {path} does not verify.
ui.key.keyring: Keyring: {path} ({count} key(s)); * marks the key that signs.
ui.key.rotated: Rotated the signing key. The new key is at {path} and signs from now on.
ui.key.retired: Key {key_id} is retired as of {when}; what it signed before then still verifies.
ui.key.archived: The previous private key was moved to {path}, not deleted.
ui.key.revoked: Key {key_id} is marked revoked in {path}. Nothing it ever signed will be accepted again.
ui.key.rotate_revoke_conflict: --rotate and --revoke ask for two different things; pass one of them.
ui.attest.tsa_failed: No package was written: the timestamp authority request failed. {detail}
ui.check.timestamp_matches_manifest: the RFC 3161 time-stamp covers this manifest
ui.check.signing_key_in_validity: the signing key was allowed to sign when this was signed
ui.check.tsa_trust_store_loaded: the TSA trust store you supplied could be read
ui.coverage.heading: coverage
ui.coverage.reason.not_applicable_to_format: this format has no such surface
ui.coverage.reason.outside_static_execution: outside the scope of a static scanner
ui.coverage.reason.not_readable_from_bytes: not a fact any file can carry
ui.coverage.reason.budget_exhausted: a budget was reached before the end
ui.coverage.reason.member_unreadable: part of it would not open
ui.policy.no_subjects: No artifact here is a format this tool reads, so there is nothing to decide about.
ui.policy.every_rule_satisfied: every rule was satisfied by every subject
ui.policy.exception_expired: the exception waiving {rule} expired on {on} and is no longer honoured ({owner})
ui.receipt.not_verified: does NOT verify over this document
ui.receipt.no_anchor: no trust anchors were supplied, so nobody has vouched for this key
ui.receipt.untrusted: NOT in the supplied trust anchors
ui.agent.nothing: no dangerous combination in this declaration
ui.agent.diff.risk_increasing: changes that widen what the agent can do
ui.agent.diff.unexplained: the agent digest changed and nothing above explains it. This is a defect in this command, not a clean diff - please report it.
ui.paths.unresolved: sub-agents nobody resolved, so their capabilities are not in this answer: {names}
ui.paths.none: no open route from untrusted input to a consequence
ui.state.optional: every other command still works without this; it is memory, not a prerequisite
ui.state.no_sources: no sources registered yet: `actaira source add <uri>`
ui.state.unknown_source: {id} is not a registered source. `actaira source list` shows what is.
ui.state.unknown_asset: this store has never seen that asset, so it has no dependents recorded. That is not the same as having none.
ui.state.truncated: the walk stopped at its depth limit, so this list may be short
ui.watch.state.baseline: BASELINE - first observation, there was nothing to compare with
ui.watch.state.source_drift: SOURCE DRIFT - the revision moved and the content did not
ui.watch.state.incomplete: INCOMPLETE - the listing could not be read in full, so no baseline was written
ui.watch.explain.baseline: First observation. There was nothing to compare against, so a baseline is written and nothing is reported as changed.
ui.watch.explain.unchanged: Same listing, same digests. Nothing is re-analysed and nothing new is written.
ui.watch.explain.source_drift: The revision moved and every digest is the same. A re-tag or a mirror re-upload: recorded, and not the alarm a weight file changing is.
ui.watch.explain.content_drift: Bytes moved. Only the changed artifacts are re-analysed, and only the evidence bound to the digests that are gone is superseded.
ui.watch.explain.incomplete: The listing could not be read in full, so no baseline is written. The stored state is left exactly as it was.
ui.check.dsse_envelope_valid: the in-toto Statement verifies against the same key
ui.decide.none: no policy decisions recorded yet: `actaira policy check --state <db>` files one
ui.decide.reassess_header: Decisions that need a second look
ui.decide.validity.current: still applies: every input it recorded still describes its subject
ui.decide.validity.requires_reassessment: needs reassessment: an input no longer describes its subject
ui.decide.validity.undetermined: cannot tell: this workspace does not hold enough to judge
ui.decide.reason.no_recorded_inputs: filed before this store recorded what a decision depended on
ui.decide.reason.evidence_superseded: {evidence} was superseded: it was taken about {was}, and {subject} is now {now}
ui.decide.reason.evidence_stale: {evidence} is stale: nobody has re-observed {subject} within the freshness it was given
ui.decide.reason.evidence_revoked: {evidence} was revoked: the key, source or attestation behind it was withdrawn
ui.decide.reason.evidence_untrusted: {evidence} is intact and this environment does not accept it
ui.decide.reason.evidence_not_in_store: {evidence} is not in this workspace, so nothing here can say what became of it
ui.decide.reason.subject_digest_changed: {subject} was {was} when this was decided and is now {now}
ui.decide.reason.subject_digest_not_recorde: {subject} was named without a digest, so there is nothing to compare
ui.decide.reason.subject_not_in_store: {subject} is not an asset this workspace holds
ui.decide.reason.subject_digest_unknown: {subject} is recorded and carries no digest, so the two cannot be compared
ui.decide.reason.unknown_input_role: an input recorded by a release that knew a kind of dependency this one does not
ui.change.state.listing_recorded: listing recorded again; neither its artifacts nor its revision moved
ui.change.none: no observations recorded yet: `actaira source add` then `actaira watch` records one
ui.change.supersession_unknown: What each of these invalidated at the time is not recorded. An evidence record keeps its current state and not its history, so this list says what changed and not what that stopped counting.
ui.scan.header: Reading the sessions {source} recorded on this machine
ui.scan.incomplete: {count} session(s) declare a gap: something happened that was not observed
ui.scan.demo: Reading the synthetic demo session shipped with the package.
ui.scan.written: wrote {count} trace(s) and their digests to {path}
ui.scan.not_evidence: CAPTURE LEVEL L0: this transcript was written by the agent being audited, about itself. Authenticity is not evaluated here and cannot be. It is diagnosis and retrospective analysis, not evidence a third party can rely on. Use `actaira watch` to record a run from outside the agent.
ui.watch.header: Recorded session {session} at capture level L1
ui.watch.observed: {events} tool call(s) observed from outside the agent
ui.watch.complete: complete: every observed call has a recorded result and the session ended
ui.watch.incomplete: INCOMPLETE: the gaps above are what this run could not observe
ui.watch.written: wrote the trace and its digest to {path}
ui.watch.no_command: watch needs a command to run: actaira watch -- <command>
